title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double With Towel Bar (Waverly Place Collection) | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf that gives you two levels of space plus an integrated towel bar in one streamlined installation.

  • Two-tier organization: double shelf design helps keep toiletries and daily essentials within reach
  • Tempered glass: 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for strength and safety
  • Solid brass hardware: crafted with solid brass components, including a gallery rail to help keep items secure
  • Integrated towel bar: adds a convenient hanging spot for towels
  • Clean installation: concealed screw mounting hardware

Specs

  • Collection: Waverly Place
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Dimensions: 16-inch L x 5-inch W x 12-inch H (5-inch projection)
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 inch (3/8 inch)
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4-inch
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

This piece is designed to coordinate with transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories from the Waverly Place collection.

_previous.title: 16 Inch Gallery Double Glass Shelf with Towel Bar
_previous.description: Add a flare of style to your décor with this decorative glass shelf. Shelf can be used anywhere in the home for a great space to store your products. Gallery rail will keep your items secure while the integrated towel bar provides a creative space for your towels. Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.
